what: The author's own Meta ad test sending traffic to Shopee affiliate links, Vietnam, 2-8 Oct 2026. Not PayPal and not the demo shop: real money, used to show the gap Paid Signal closes.

sources.meta: Meta Marketing API daily insights per ad, stored by the author's affiliate system (current_meta_daily); MEDIA_SPEND before 10% VAT
sources.orders: Shopee Affiliate official conversion export imported 9 Oct 2026, attributed to ads one-to-one by Sub_id1 (current_commission_line)
sources.cross_check: matches the 12 Oct 2026 business review in the author's affiliate repo (1,118,260 VND spend for 2-8 Oct, 70,577 VND expected commission)

period: 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-08: Meta spend and clicks cut to the days the Shopee export covers (orders to 2026-10-08)

totals.commission_cash_paid_note: no payout statement covering these orders was recorded; unknown is not zero

reading: By clicks the polo ads lead (287, 283 and 181). By money the jacket ad leads: 5th by clicks (171), 2 completed orders, 50,168 VND, 71% of all expected commission. Two orders: a pattern, not a result.
26 of 33 ads produced no order at all yet took 59% of spend and 57% of the clicks Meta reported.
Expected commission was 6.3% of media spend, and no payout for it had been recorded. Meta optimised for the clicks it could see.
campaign_objective: OUTCOME_TRAFFIC for all 33 ads: Meta was asked for clicks
